{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, underestimating bull market momentum and overestimating bear market reversals.",
    "Sentiment positivity amplifies model forecast bias, causing undershoot on the buy side during optimistic sentiment regimes.",
    "When price exhibits strong upward momentum, model mean-reversion tendencies cause forecasts to trail reality by 1-2 days.",
    "Sentiment turning from negative to positive removes model's discounting of downside risk, creating forecast-actual divergences.",
    "Pricing around market inflection points breaks model's statistical assumptions, generating systematic forecast errors.",
    "Sentiment volatility correlates with forecast error magnitude, higher sentiment change rates = larger deviations from model",
    "Model underperforms during price acceleration phases because it implicitly assumes mean reversion that doesn't hold in trending markets"
] }
